component.name: About This Computer
component.summary: System information and running applications for LCOS

description.p: About This Computer is a classic Mac OS 9 style window for the Lunduke Computer Operating System. It shows the LCOS version, memory, CPU and graphics, the Supporters of LCOS, and the running graphical applications with their memory use.
Each running application can be closed from its row with Force Close, after a warning that lists its open windows.
Reads /usr/lib/os-release when /etc/os-release is missing or unreadable, adds this AppStream metadata, and makes the UI tests reliable on busy machines.
Dark theme support, safer Force Close with window titles, and an updated Supporters list.
